messages:
elaine_cs: FYI onboarding SSO callbacks failing for several Dedicated customers in eu-west-1, started ~11:05 UTC. some are in renewal window. need a short customer note + prioritized renewal-risk outreach.
omar_eng: investigating. early signal shows callback 401s while new pool nodes initialize. looks like a timing window where tokens expire.
kevin_support: affected tenant ids logged: r-301, r-302, r-433. opening tickets and adding timezones.
elaine_cs: draft customer-facing note (keep very short):
"Were aware of intermittent SSO failures for Dedicated onboarding in eu-west-1. Engineers have deployed a mitigation; you may see retries for ~60 minutes. No action needed on your side. We'll follow up with confirmation and a one-time credit if you were impacted. Redwood CS"
nina_sales: for renewals <30 days, escalate to AMs immediately and offer prioritized onboarding + 15% credit. please compile list.
omar_eng: mitigation = warm auth-proxy routing + increase callback retry jitter. feature-flagged, canary now.
deploy_bot: canary-deploy started at 1901235120.
kevin_support: adding INC-5987 to all tickets and scheduling office hours slots for high-touch tenants.
elaine_cs: internal CSM script bullets: acknowledge + INC ref, ETA 60m for verification, credit offer, office hours scheduling, escalate if renewal <30d.
omar_eng: canary metrics after 10m: r-301 & r-302 improved, r-433 still failing due to legacy SAML metadata. pushing a patch for metadata decoding.
kevin_support: outbound status sent to affected tenants with INC-5987 and office hours opt-in.
elaine_cs: action items: 1) omar - finish metadata patch and post RCA (ETA 45m). 2) kevin - ensure outbound template logged and tickets updated (now). 3) nina - compile <30d renewals and AM list (ETA 2h). 4) elaine - finalize credit amounts and exec note (ETA 3h).
elaine_cs: keeping thread for essential updates only. will produce CSM digest in 90 minutes for account teams. :pray:
